ns2:section.sectionText: Theme: UI/UX Project. The boundaries between physical product design and UI/UX design are getting more and more fuzzy. Many ID students on graduation will work in the UI/UX area. This section aims to give you some experience working in this space, with two alternative project briefs and the opportunity to BYOP ( bring your own project ). In all cases, you will be expected to use a human-centered design approach through research, user involvement, ideation, prototyping and communication. Online.
